about: MN10300 single-instruction vectors, recorded: the CPU core's instruction-level regression (test_vectors on both engines, check_isa, check_perf P1). Memory windows (address, size) are filled per case with random.Random(seed).randbytes(size) in this order: 0x8000+0x100, 0x10000+0x400, 0x20000+0x200. in = d0-d3, a0-a3, sp, pc, psw, mdr, lir, lar. out.regs lists changed registers (pc always); out.undef = PSW flag bits left undefined; out.mem = changed bytes. src: oracle = GDB 15.2 sim/mn10300; oracle+spec = sim corrected per the ISA manual; spec = ISA manual; udf-spec = docs/om1-udf-spec.md.
